Description:
Install or update PICO development knowledge

Usage:
  $ pico-cli knowledge <command> [options]

Commands:
  doctor          Check knowledge server configurations and dependencies
  list            List installed PICO development knowledge versions
  pull [version]  Install or update the PICO development knowledge
  server          Start the PICO development knowledge MCP server

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
